description: We're designing a four-storey, sprinklered wood-frame apartment with eight units per floor on a mid-block lot. To make the floor plate work we want a single exit stair serving every floor, with a pressurized stair and a short corridor. Each floor is about 600 m2.

missing_info.why: Section A of the variance form

missing_info.field: travel distance and occupant load per floor
missing_info.why: mitigation and comparison with the single-exit limits

gold.departure: Each floor area served by one exit instead of at least two, in a building above the single-exit height limit.

should_cite.why: single-exit allowance limited to buildings of not more than 2 storeys
dwelling unit doors opening into an exit stair

must_not_cite.why: a four-storey building is not within Part 9

gold.engineering_reason: Four-storey apartment is outside the exemption; authenticated architectural and engineering design is required.

authoring.author: Batatis evaluation builder (Claude Opus 5.5)
